name: communications-day-event-mvp
description: Monorepo foundation for the Communications Day event MVP.

scripts.dev: pnpm --filter @communications-day/backend run dev & pnpm --filter @communications-day/frontend run dev
scripts.lint: pnpm --filter @communications-day/backend run lint && pnpm --filter @communications-day/frontend run lint
scripts.test: pnpm --filter @communications-day/backend run test && pnpm --filter @communications-day/frontend run test
scripts.build: pnpm --filter @communications-day/backend run build && pnpm --filter @communications-day/frontend run build
